errors.name: UnauthorizedLiquidator
errors.msg: Unauthorized liquidator - only designated liquidation authority can liquidate loans

errors.name: MaxStakedNftsTooLow
errors.msg: Max staked NFTs too low (below current staked)

errors.name: InvalidNftValue
errors.msg: Invalid NFT value (must be greater than 0)

errors.name: InvalidNftCollection
errors.msg: NFT is not from an approved collection

errors.name: UnauthorizedAdmin
errors.msg: Unauthorized: Caller is not the admin wallet

errors.name: RegistryFull
errors.msg: Registry is full (max 100 collections per registry)

errors.name: InvalidUtilizationSlope
errors.msg: Invalid utilization slope (must be <= 100% for slope1, <= 200% for slope2)

errors.name: InvalidRevenueSplitTotal
errors.msg: Revenue split percentages must add up to exactly 100%

errors.name: OutstandingDebtExists
errors.msg: Outstanding debt exists - cannot withdraw NFT

errors.name: NftNotDeposited
errors.msg: NFT not found in deposited collateral

errors.name: InvalidWhiskeyPrice
errors.msg: Invalid WHISKEY price (must be greater than 0)

errors.name: InsufficientPaymentAmount
errors.msg: Insufficient payment amount (WHISKEY value less than debt)

errors.name: InvalidAssetMint
errors.msg: Invalid asset mint for capital vault

errors.name: InvalidVaultAuthority
errors.msg: Invalid vault authority - must be global market PDA
